# Claude transcript provenance

`idle.jsonl` is a redacted copy of a `type:user` record at line 38 of
`~/.claude/projects/<project-id>/<session-id>.jsonl`.
`queued.jsonl` is a redacted copy of an `attachment/queued_command` record at
line 37 of another local project transcript with the same layout. The source
paste markers and receipt-relevant record fields remain; machine paths and
conversation content are omitted.
